instruction.text: Charlie’s bakery is having a cake sale. The bakery made £99 selling to 100 customers. How much did each customer spend if everyone paid the same amount?

atoms.b: Each customer would have to spend <mat>£<gap>0.99</gap></mat>.

instruction.text: Jacky bought a string that is 84 cm long. How many metres long is the string?
There are 100 players at Philippa’s football tournament. During the lunch break, the players are provided with 14 kg of oranges. How many kilograms of oranges does each player get?

atoms.b: Each player gets <mat><gap>0.14</gap></mat> kg of oranges.

instruction.text: Alex is collecting pennies he finds around the neighbourhood. At the end of the month he has 73 pence. How many pounds has Alex collected?
Clara has 35 packs of marbles and wants to split them equally among 100 people at her school.

atoms.a: Her friend Emily says every person should get 3.5 packs. Is she correct?
How many packs of marbles do the 100 people actually get?
atoms.b: Each person gets <mat><gap>0.35</gap></mat> packs of marbles.

atoms.a: How many people would there have to be for Emily to be correct?
atoms.b: There would have to be <mat><gap>10</gap></mat> people.
